Gift of the Timeways
10% of base mana
Instant cast30 sec cooldown
Heals an ally for 19 to 25, scaling with your Spirit and Spell Power.

If your Order is greater than your Chromatic, the target is Healed for an additional 8% of their Maximum Health and is granted a damage absorption shield based on your Spirit for up to 6 sec. This effect cannot Critically Strike.

If your Chromatic is greater than your Order, the target Enrages for 10 sec, increasing all damage they deal by 5%, and increasing their Melee, Ranged and Spell Haste by 8%.
